title: Review + benchmark
goal_hi: Week 2 ke patterns aur words yaad karke Monday small talk confidently karna.

quiz.prompt: I ___ start work at ten. (word order)

mission.title_hi: Ek colleague se ek real small-talk question English me poochho — “How was your weekend?” ya “Do you like ___?” — aur uska answer suno.
steps_hi: Ek small-talk question chuno: “How was your weekend?” ya “Do you like ___?”
Ek follow-up poochho — “What about you?” ya “Why?”
